title: Make() with EnableSmartTruncate=false and default MaxLength=0 returns empty slug
property: With MaxLength unset (0), slugs are not shortened, so a simple lowercase word is returned unchanged regardless of EnableSmartTruncate
evidence: Doc on MaxLength: 'By default slugs aren't shortened.' The non-smart branch `len(slug) >= MaxLength` does not guard MaxLength > 0 (unlike the smart branch).

title: Make() with MaxLength can return slug ending in underscore, failing IsSlug
property: All output of Make(text) passes IsSlug (when non-empty)
expected: a slug without trailing '_' (e.g. "0") that passes IsSlug
evidence: IsSlug doc: 'All output from slug.Make(text) should pass this test' and slugs may not end with '-' or '_'. smartTruncate cuts text[:MaxLength] without re-trimming '_' / '-'.
